attchmntText: Siemens Energy India Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 25, 2026, recommended Final Dividend of Rs. 12 per equity share.
voiceSummary: Siemens Energy India Limited Board approved audited financial results for the year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 17,809 million rupees, up from 11,001 million rupees in the previous year. Revenue from operations stood at 102,432 million rupees. The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 12 per equity share, totaling 600 percent, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting. Payment is scheduled for February 10, 2027. Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP issued an unmodified audit opinion on the financial statements. The Board meeting concluded on November 25, 2026.
